craft_claim: The reflective tone must retain the qualities psychology attaches to reflection — coherent, curious, purposeful self-examination — and avoid those attached to rumination and brooding — repetitive, self-critical cycling that resolves nothing — because unresolved cycling reads to readers as navel-gazing.

supporting_evidence.location: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology 76(2):284-304; Rumination-Reflection Questionnaire factor analysis and personality correlates
supporting_evidence.note: Distinguishes two facets of private self-consciousness: reflection (coherent, purposeful, interested self-examination, associated with openness) and rumination (uncertain, self-critical, repetitive examination, associated with neuroticism); they load separately and predict differently.

supporting_evidence.location: Cognitive Therapy and Research 27(3):247-259; factor analysis and one-year longitudinal follow-up
supporting_evidence.note: Splits the Ruminative Responses Scale into brooding (passive, self-critical comparison) and reflection (purposeful, problem-focused inwardness); over one year brooding predicted increases in depressive symptoms while reflection predicted decreases.

counterevidence.note: Inwardness as measured is a mixed facet: the same posture functions as benign reflection only when a question is actually being worked, and as brooding when it is not. The craft boundary is movement, not posture — which means 'reflective' cannot be defined by first-person volume alone.

scope: Voice quality of sustained first-person introspection in any form; the governing diagnostic for the tone's signature failure.
exceptions: Works that deliberately model rumination (trauma narratives, depressive first person) are exempt when the cycling is the character's condition and the narration marks it as such; the card's diagnostic governs the work's default narration.
